scripts.docker:lint: docker compose run --rm web npm run lint
scripts.docker:test: docker compose run --rm web npm run test
scripts.docker:build: docker compose run --rm web npm run build
scripts.backend:start: docker compose --profile tools run --rm supabase start
scripts.backend:stop: docker compose --profile tools run --rm supabase stop
scripts.backend:status: docker compose --profile tools run --rm supabase status
scripts.backend:reset: docker compose --profile tools run --rm supabase db reset
scripts.backend:functions: docker compose --profile tools run --rm --service-ports supabase functions serve --env-file supabase/.env.local
